''See also: [[Wei Jin Amon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Wei Jin Amon, also known as Amon, is a seventeen-year-old [[sacred artist]] and the [[blood]] grandson of the [[Wei clan]] [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]], [[Wei Jin Sairus]]. An [[Iron]]-stage practitioner, he is characterized by his long, thick black hair and his use of a spear, which he often carries wrapped in green shadesilk. During an arena match, Amon served as a representative for his clan to test the skills of [[Lindon|Wei Shi Lindon]]. Although he demonstrated significant speed and strength, utilizing [[Foxfire|foxfire]] around his spearhead, he ultimately lost the engagement. Following a period of chaos and mental instability during combat, Amon was forced to admit defeat. He has expressed interest in joining the [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]], contingent upon his ability to prove his value through combat.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Wei Jin Amon is the [[blood]] grandson of the [[Wei clan]] [[Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch]]. [[Kelsa]] is an individual who might engage in combat with him.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As the [[blood]] grandson of the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]], Wei Jin Amon is a member of the [[Wei clan]] who possesses an [[Iron|iron]] badge. During combat, he utilizes a spear and wields purple [[Foxfire|foxfire]] to fight. Though he was once seen crouched with his weapon ready for battle and considered a potential opponent for [[Kelsa]], he eventually sustained injuries. Ultimately, Amon was defeated by the [[hornet Remnants]].}}
